project_context.target_audience: Recruiters and hiring managers in analytics/AI, fellow developers.
project_context.persona: Sujal Gupta, Data Analyst / BI / AI Enthusiast.
project_context.vibe: World-class, cinematic, dark, minimal, motion-driven. Awwwards Site-of-the-Day aesthetic.
project_context.core_goal: Secure internships and full-time analytics roles by demonstrating technical depth and premium design taste.

theme_strategy.rationale: High contrast, immersive dark theme to build depth, emphasize typography, and let glowing highlights and glassmorphism elements stand out.

headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, large numbers. Apply tracking-tighter (-2% letter spacing on main hero titles).

stats.usage: Counters, data points (6.36M+), code snippets, GitHub stats.

glassmorphism.usage: Navbar, stat bento cards, contact form wrapper, feature cards.

ambient_glow.usage: Behind the hero portrait, behind key CTAs, softly breaking the pure black background.

noise_texture.usage: Universal overlay to kill digital flatness and give a film/cinematic feel.

layouts_and_grids.asymmetry: Use negative space aggressively. Do not perfectly align everything to the center. Align content to the left or right to create visual tension.

page_sections.name: Cinematic Loading Screen
page_sections.spec: Fixed z-[100] overlay, dark background. 'SG' monogram with expanding lines. 0-100% JetBrains Mono counter. Fades out on complete.

page_sections.name: Floating Glass Navbar
page_sections.spec: Sticky top, fixed width or floating pill shape. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5. Hide-on-scroll-down, show-on-scroll-up using framer-motion.

page_sections.name: Hero Section
page_sections.spec: Split asymmetric layout. Left: 'Sujal Gupta', fluid H1, Space Grotesk, -2% tracking. Rotating job titles (Data Analyst / BI / AI). Right: Portrait inside a clipped glass frame with ambient blue glow and slow floating particles. Absolute positioned stat bento cards: '7+ Projects', '6.36M+ Records', '122K+ Jobs', 'CGPA 8.8'.

page_sections.name: About Me
page_sections.spec: Editorial magazine layout. Massive typographic pull quote. Left-aligned body text.

page_sections.name: Experience & Education Timeline
page_sections.spec: Vertical animated line using framer-motion useScroll. Glowing dots on active nodes. Entries for IIT Patna, AKTU, Deloitte, JPMorgan Chase, Tata GenAI.

page_sections.name: Skills Interactive Wall
page_sections.spec: No standard progress bars. Interactive bento wall of tags, icons, and tech clusters. Use hover effects.

page_sections.name: Featured Projects (7 Immersive Studies)
page_sections.spec: Full-screen sticky or horizontally scrolling sections. Business context, tech stack (JetBrains Mono), results, and live CTAs. Dark abstract data-viz images as backgrounds with bg-black/60 overlay.

page_sections.name: Analytics Workflow Roadmap
page_sections.spec: Horizontal scrolling container mapping 10 steps of the analytics process. Framer motion x-axis translation linked to scroll progress.

page_sections.name: Certifications & Achievements
page_sections.spec: Glass card grid for certs. Animated timeline with JetBrains Mono number counters for achievements.

page_sections.name: GitHub & Live Stats
page_sections.spec: Live contribution graph aesthetic, pinned repos, dark UI.

page_sections.name: Why Hire Me & Contact
page_sections.spec: 4 premium cards for 'Why Hire Me'. Contact form using premium glassmorphism inputs, border-white/10, focus-ring with #38BDF8.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_behavior: Implement smooth scroll. Since lenis is often problematic in standard React without proper setup, simulate momentum with Framer Motion or use pure CSS scroll-behavior if complex, but heavily prioritize Framer Motion useInView and useScroll for parallax and reveals.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: All cards need hover lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle border glow. CTAs need magnetic feel or arrow sliding animations.

hero_portrait.description: Dramatic dark portrait to be used in the right side of the hero section, clipped inside a glass frame.

project_ai_dashboard.description: Futuristic digital interface for project case studies.

project_data_viz.description: Tech radar interface for analytics and BI project showcases.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to every button, link, form input, and major section container. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images uses proper overlays (e.g., bg-black/60) to maintain WCAG AA contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.motion_preference: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion configurations.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL: The application uses .js files, NOT .tsx. Write all React components in Javascript.
CRITICAL: Do NOT add text-align: center to the root App container. Left alignment is required for readability and tension.
CRITICAL: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for the sticky navbar. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/50 or bg-white/5.
CRITICAL: For layout asymmetry, use Tailwind Grids and leave columns empty (e.g., col-span-4 col-start-2).
Build custom HTML/Tailwind elements for this portfolio layout rather than relying entirely on pre-built generic standard inputs, as this is a premium marketing page.
Use framer-motion extensively for scroll-reveals (initial={opacity: 0, y: 40} whileInView={opacity: 1, y: 0}).
Include subtle noise backgrounds or radial gradients (e.g., bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-blue-900/20 via-[#050505] to-[#050505]) to add depth.
